mission: expand scientific falsification coverage with low-cost read-only public sources

evidence: no DESI or GWOSC source ids were present before this action

SHADOW.note: An initial loose DESI scan was rejected because it matched substrings such as design; only word-boundary reruns were admitted.

observations.observation: DR1 is the latest public spectroscopic data release; DR2 cosmology result products exist but the underlying DR2 spectra/redshifts are not yet public.
API v2 is current and recommended; it is read-only, paginated and exposes runs, catalogs, events, parameter estimates and strain data.
FTPS batch staging is being discontinued on 2026-10-01; MAST recommends curl download scripts or astroquery.mast.

NO_ACTION.reason: Leaving DESI and GWOSC absent preserves a measurable scientific-source coverage gap at negligible implementation cost.

executed_actions: added gwosc scientific source using API v2 base URL
updated JWST/MAST retrieval guidance to prefer current astroquery or curl mechanisms
performed read-only canaries on two independent machines

epistemic_memory.mechanism: independent read-only network canary before deeper adapter work
epistemic_memory.outcome: GWOSC and DESI endpoints reachable from separate nodes
DESI produced false positives through words such as design; exact token boundaries required
